For k>=2 the implementation adds the unconditional self-ring marginal 1 - e^(-w_i*t_min), ignoring other clocks. This includes exactly-one-other mass; overcount is the >=k-others event.

Bound: P(>=2 others) <= sum_{a<b} p_a p_b <= (sum_{j!=i} w_j)^2 t^2 / 2; integrated over [0,t_min] this is at most w_i (sum_{j!=i} w_j)^2 t_min^3 / 6 <= n^2 e^(-3C)/6 <= 1e-11. Count mixture preserves the bound.
Only the k=1 first-draw case has no lower-tail bias; k>=2 carries the stated bound and total quadrature error still remains.
